title: Minecraft Cooldown Misc
description: After you use an item, all items with a "minecraft:cooldown" component with the same "category" become unusable for the amount of seconds specified in "duration".

category.title: Category
category.description: All items with the same "category" are put on cooldown when one is used.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: How long the item is on cooldown before being able to be used again.
